title: Otter wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='fur' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#b5763c'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#8a5223'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='belly' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f2cfa0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#d9ae76'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='24' fill='url(#fur)'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='16' ry='17' fill='url(#belly)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='24' ry='21' fill='url(#fur)'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='22' r='6' fill='#8a5223'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='22' r='6' fill='#8a5223'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='22' r='3' fill='#c98f57'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='22' r='3' fill='#c98f57'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='15' ry='11' fill='url(#belly)'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='5' ry='3.6' fill='#4b2e1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='48.5' cy='40' rx='1.6' ry='1.1' fill='#7a5237'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 45 v3 M50 48 q-4 4 -7 1 M50 48 q4 4 7 1' stroke='#6b4226' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <path d='M24 32 q3 -6 9 -5 l2 4' fill='#222a3a'/>
  <rect x='26' y='30' width='20' height='13' rx='5' fill='#222a3a'/>
  <rect x='54' y='30' width='20' height='13' rx='5' fill='#222a3a'/>
  <rect x='28' y='32' width='16' height='9' rx='3.5' fill='#3aa8c8'/>
  <rect x='56' y='32' width='16' height='9' rx='3.5' fill='#3aa8c8'/>
  <rect x='30' y='33' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a8e6f2'/>
  <rect x='58' y='33' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a8e6f2'/>
  <rect x='45' y='33' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#222a3a'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='66' rx='8' ry='12' transform='rotate(20 22 66)' fill='#9c5f2b'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='66' rx='8' ry='12' transform='rotate(-20 78 66)' fill='#9c5f2b'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='88' r='6' fill='#8a5223'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='88' r='6' fill='#8a5223'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='86' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#c98f57'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='86' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#c98f57'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M38 46 h-9 M38 49 h-8 M62 46 h9 M62 49 h8' stroke='#e8c9a0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
